name: Prusament ASA @Prusa CORE One INDX 1.0HF - T8
filament_notes: Prusament ASA 1.75 mm for the 1.0 mm high-flow nozzle on T8 of the mixed-nozzle INDX printers. Prusa has no 1.0 ASA, so this follows Prusament ASA @COREONE HF0.8 (270 C, bed 110, fan 20-30, bridges 30, layer time 20/20 s, min speed 15) with the INDX HF0.4 values where the 0.8 profile has none (retract 0.8, chamber 55/40). Cap 30 mm3/s as on the INDX HF0.4 and the T8 PETG profiles (Prusa 0.8 is 36 x about 0.82); pressure advance 0.022 x0.447 x0.69 = 0.007. Shrinkage compensation 0.22 percent comes from the Prusa CORE One ASA group. Raise the cap with a max-flow test.
